title: Calli: estimated human active time for 10 existing comments

assumptions.basis: Illustrative analyst-selected inputs, not population averages or observed timings.

separate_measured_reference_not_comparab.scope: Historical approved-text PRONOTE writer, excludes dictation, preparation and human approval time. Not the new autonomous end-to-end flow.

limitations: Both human-active-time bars are estimates, including the human using Calli. No measured human baseline exists.
Texts are already composed; pedagogical assessment and comment composition are excluded from both arms.
Manual arm assumes retyping, not a batch import, macro, or copy-paste workflow.
Same final human review allowance in both arms. No extra validation click is assumed in Calli.
No failed writes, transcription corrections, interruptions, setup or warm-up included; any intervention reduces estimated savings.
Waiting is not counted as active time only when the human can genuinely work on another task.
This range is sensitivity to selected typing speeds, not a confidence interval or measured population range.
Do not extrapolate to school budgets, jobs or annual savings without actual usage and cost data.
